java_locations.role: Selects an explicit note BACK color before the merged note style and retains the resulting HColor, including HColorGradient, as noteBackgroundColor.
Routes note outline paths through DriverRectangleSvg fill selection rather than flattening their background paint.
Recognizes HColorGradient, asks SvgGraphics for the shared tuple-interned resource id, and paints the path with url(#id).
Shares one source-seeded gradient registry across class and note shapes in first-paint order.

rust_locations.role: Accepts only note background values lacking slash or pipe and therefore drops a valid note gradient to the historical solid default.
Inventories selected class entity gradients but omits note nodes from the same SVEK emission stream and shared SVG resource namespace.
All ordinary note path painters consume ResolvedNoteStyle.background, so one typed paint-selection fix can cover folded body and corner paths across note topologies.

claimed_invariant: A class-diagram note background is a typed paint selected from explicit note BACK color before merged note style. Gradient paint remains a color1/color2/policy tuple through folded-path emission. Notes and classes register into one source-seeded SVG gradient namespace in SVEK node paint order; identical tuples reuse an id even across shape kinds, while differing policies remain distinct.
causal_divergence: The frozen source selects #FFFACD/#FFFFFF through noteBackgroundColor for two floating notes. Java preserves that HColorGradient, interns one resource on the first note path, and both folded paths of both notes reference it. Rust's ResolvedNoteStyle::for_note rejects slash or pipe values as non-solid, substitutes #FEFFDD, and class_gradients never sees note paint. The three missing elements are exactly one linearGradient and its two stops; the ordinary no-oracle SVEK note geometry and text already match.
planned_model_change: Rename and extend the class gradient inventory to traverse the complete SVEK node emission order. Select raw note background paint with explicit note color precedence, register gradient tuples alongside class paints, and resolve ResolvedNoteStyle.background to the shared generated id without changing solid-color normalization. Ensure the degenerate single-note envelope also emits its selected definitions. Add fresh renamed tests for all policies, duplicate note reuse, inline-over-skinparam precedence, mixed note/class tuple reuse, and floating versus attached versus single-note topology.

It does not alter note geometry, text metrics, border paint, note parsing, non-class diagram families, comparator behavior, golden data, or fixture eligibility.
